**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 574 4.0 **Usage** held in 1 hand --- This sprig of berry-festooned holly and mistletoe doesn't wilt or rot. It can be used as a primal focus, and it also grants the creature holding it a +1 item bonus to [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) checks. **Activate** Interact; **Frequency** once per 10 minutes; **Effect** You squeeze juice from one of the berries and smear it onto a [club](/Weapons.aspx?ID=2) or [staff](/Weapons.aspx?ID=12) to cast [_shillelagh_](/Spells.aspx?ID=282) upon it.
**Activate** Interact; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You can twine the sprig around the wrist of one hand and touch a tree to cast [_tree shape_](/Spells.aspx?ID=342) upon yourself, except instead of a becoming a tree, you become a vine on the touched tree.
name: Primeval Mistletoe
